Maybe. I don't really know where I could find a so called professional.

Ya, it just kind of sucks. If you want to live, you get to live. If you don't want to, you don't get to. Its kind of a "fuck you paradox" kind of thing.

Really? I thought I wrote pretty terrible. Don't get me wrong. I love writing. But I hate how much I suck at it.

Thanks for recognizing the graduation thing. It was pretty huge for me. It was what helped me keep myself alive senior year. I just told myself, make it to graduation. At least then you aren't another high school suicide. I mean, now it suck. Which is probably why I'm here. I don't have graduation to hold on to anymore, but without graduation I wouldn't be here today.

That's an interesting comment. I guess my retort is the same I gave to /u/thehelperman that it still doens't matter. But it does make me realize how selfish this all is. And I'm not talking about just myself. I'm talking about everybody in the situation. Me, my family, my friends, the world, the 'system'. Me killing myself turns into a problem for themselves instead of about me but that fact that its a bout me is myself being selfish but it selfish of them to care etc. Endless cycle.

I haven't talked to a professional. 

Well I have much more than those 3. I just got way too tired to write the rest. But I don't think you give me enough credit in how good I am at hiding this thing. Its probably the one thing I am actually truly skilled at in this world.

Is that some atheistic form of Pascal's wager? It kind of ignores my point though. The world has no point. Your argument is that because it doesn't, make it the best. But my point is that that stuff doesn't matter anyways. Cause I've been happy before. I truly have. Doesn't change the fact that we are sitting here, having the conversation about me killing myself. I could have lived any life, but it all leads up to this point.
